Third-Party Notices
===================

GPAC / MP4Box
-------------

StreamRecorder release packages may include MP4Box from the GPAC project for RAW AAC to M4A remuxing.

Target bundled build:

- Package: GPAC-MP4Box-26.02-rev0-g118e60a9_Win_GCC161.7z
- Version: GPAC-MP4Box v26.02-rev0-g118e60a9-ab-suite
- Build date: May 02, 2026
- Compiler: GCC 16.1.0
- Variant: MINI build, with encoders, decoders, audio output, and video output disabled
- Bundled executable: Win64/MP4Box.exe
- Bundled executable SHA256: DDFF6C4EEE526EA92B65A953370A4CE9C5CFB374A140A2D98B76A0A23AED895B

GPAC project links:

- http://gpac.io/
- https://github.com/gpac/gpac

GPAC is licensed by its upstream project. Keep the GPAC license files from the distributed package together with the bundled MP4Box files.

BASS 2.4
--------

StreamRecorder may include the BASS 2.4 playback library from Un4seen
Developments Ltd. The corresponding `bass.txt` file is included in
`Tools/BASS/` and contains the upstream license and terms of use.

Project link:

- https://www.un4seen.com/

BASS_AAC
--------

The package includes the BASS_AAC 2.4.7.2 add-on for decoding AAC and AAC+
streams, including Shoutcast AAC+ streams. The corresponding DLL files are in
`Tools/BASS/x64/` and `Tools/BASS/x86/`. The included `bass_aac.txt` and
`bass_aac-gpl.txt` files contain the upstream terms and license text.

Add-on source:

- https://www.un4seen.com/bass.html
